comment: The registry of prior art OUTSIDE this repository. This exists because
the Heart Scale mechanic was rediscovered by accident: the operator had
already modeled it in pokemon-mono, and nothing here pointed there.
Every claim carries a repo, a commit it was verified at, and the paths
that prove it — `npm run inventory` re-verifies the paths whenever the
clone is present locally, and INVENTORY.md renders the result. A claim
nobody can point at does not belong in this file.

sources.role: The operator's primary monorepo — four earlier repos subtree-imported (see its RECEIPTS-MAP.md). Read-only prior art for this project.

capabilities.name: Heart Scale = set one IV to 31 (Run & Bun mechanic) — SOUND, PORT THIS
capabilities.notes: use_heart_scale(bag, pokemon, stat): refuses at 31, consumes from bag, recalculates stats. heart_scales_to_max, iv_quality_rating. Not shop-buyable, sell 100. Graded 2026-08-11: small, correct, and the one genuinely unique capability in engines/rlm — validated by execution.

capabilities.name: Cross-engine evidence tier — GRADE runbuncalc WITH IT, NEVER MERGE IT IN
capabilities.notes: 1,727 emulator-captured damage observations (fidelity/events-f*.json, self-describing, ROM-free) + a provider-agnostic engine contract. Its value is exactly that it is external — an engine that grades itself cannot catch a shared-wrong value (see rab's FINDINGS.md PP=10 episode). CASHED 2026-08-11: the three event files are vendored at profiles/run-and-bun/fidelity/ (mono commit be6570d, hashes in that README) so the gate runs without this clone, and rom-band.test.js grades this calculator against them — 1,727/1,727 = 100.00% in band, crits included. The corpus stays read-only prior art; nothing else was merged in.

capabilities.name: In-battle consumable selection
capabilities.notes: Best HP heal for a deficit, best status cure, best ball.

capabilities.name: Budget-constrained shop optimizer — DO NOT PORT
capabilities.notes: optimize_purchase(budget, needs). Graded 2026-08-11: fabricates shop locations ('Verdantrum Town', marts on routes that have none) with no provenance. For item availability port engines/rab/backend/src/data/rab-item-availability.ts instead — trainer-order-keyed and cites Mechanics.MD.

capabilities.name: MDP battle solver: deathless probability, expected deaths — OBJECTIVE GOOD, IMPLEMENTATION UNSOUND
capabilities.notes: Graded 2026-08-11: the death reward is SIGN-INVERTED at four sites (reward = -death_penalty with every caller passing -100.0, so the 'optimal' policy maximises deaths), the DP pass is unordered, the state key aliases distinct states, and damage is hardcoded to level 12 with a Gen 6 crit multiplier — behind 59 type-and-range tests that catch none of it. Take the OBJECTIVE (score a fight by P(no deaths), E[deaths]); rebuild the solver fresh on runbuncalc's ai/ and calc.
